says: Two hundred halberds and a mountain at our back. Let Dunmere come.
Or let the north come. We'll see which one breaks first.

folk.says: Off watch. Which means I've only half a mind to run you through.

says: Halberds for the guard, every day. Something's coming down from the mountains, and his lordship wants steel waiting.
Dunmere's smiths make pretty swords. Mine make widows.
I dig them, the necromancer undigs them. Steady work.
That one there? Dug him three times. Stubborn.

folk.says: The horses won't go near the north wall at night. Neither will I.
Gold's good in Grimhold. The company, less so. The food, worst of all.
